title: Bali
intro: This home's gorgeous natural wood accents paired with its coastal design remind me of Bali. With incredible golf course views and a beautiful open setting, Bali is both grand and quaint.

hero.alt: Bali living room with a beamed plank ceiling, a white brick fireplace and built-in shelving
